newsitem.title: UK: Treasury says UK economy can grow above trend.
newsitem.headline: Treasury says UK economy can grow above trend.

text.p: Alan Budd, chief economic adviser to the Treasury, said on Tuesday the UK economy had the capacity to grow at an above-trend rate for the next year or two.
"It is fairly clear, we believe, that the economy can grow at above trend growth for a year or two," he told House of Commons Treasury Select Committee.
Budd said UK unemployment would fall as the economy came back to trend. "It seems sensible to include that as a broadly based assumption when we produce the public sector accounts."
When asked by the Select Committee whether the public sector accounts contained optimistic forecasts for inflation, Budd said:
"This is a perfectly reasonable forecast which is consistent with all the other numbers...By and large outside forecasters have been too pessimistic on inflation."
